name: Himenomi Kurumi
source:
The alternate reality version of [url=http://vndb.org/c13945]Akira's[/url] sister [url=http://vndb.org/c13950]Kurumi[/url]. She doesn't understand why she looks different from herself, nor does [url=http://vndb.org/c13953]Kurara[/url] know. A self-styled genius magical girl from the magical world who apparently ran away from home along with her brother Akira, although he was too afraid to follow her into the dimensional gate. She goes by her mother's last name, "Himenomi", instead of her father's last name, "Nanamori".

To avoid confusion, she decides to have people call her Miruku, which is Kurumi in reverse.
